open_points.subject: zero work-balance presentation
open_points.text: State 0 now says work balance is shown “as `Completed ahead of payments` or `Unused advance payment`, or as balanced when it is zero,” while State 1’s “Derived views” still says it is “presented as `Completed ahead of payments` / `Unused advance payment`” and names no zero presentation.
open_points.question: When completed work value equals payments total, must the derived work-balance view present the `balanced` label, or must it choose one of the two labels listed in the unchanged State 1 summary?
options: Present `balanced` when the balance is zero, as the changed State 0 text and `WorkBalanceLabel` model say.
Use one of `completed_ahead_of_payments` or `unused_advance_payment`, as the unchanged State 1 derived-view sentence can be read to require.
open_points.default_guess: Present `balanced` when the balance is zero.

witness.initial: An active project has completed work value of EUR 1,000 and received payments totaling EUR 1,000.
events: A viewer or authorized staff member reads the payment summary/work balance.
outcomes: The response carries one of the two nonzero labels because the State 1 derived-view rule lists only those presentations.
witness.observer: The viewer or staff caller reading the payment summary.
